profile.headline: Software Engineer - React | JavaScript | TypeScript | Next.js | PostgreSQL
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with a track record of empowering startups, small businesses, and franchises to grow through user-focused web applications.

I collaborate closely with designers and stakeholders to build scalable, maintainable solutions that perform seamlessly across platforms. My approach combines clean, well-tested code with the latest technologies like React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and many more to deliver impactful results aligned with business goals.

With a background in Psychology, I bring a unique perspective to software development, helping me create experiences that truly resonate with users. I’m passionate about developing intuitive interfaces that not only work well but feel natural to interact with.

I’m always eager to connect with fellow professionals and explore new challenges. Let’s chat!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Quantiiv 
• Built an accessible marketing site featuring a WCAG-compliant hero video, responsive headers, and clear CTAs, using semantic HTML and ARIA roles to ensure usability across devices and assistive technologies.
• Integrated WordPress as a headless content management system using the WordPress API, enabling the Quantiiv team to publish blog content in support of their long-term content strategy and delivered ahead of schedule.

Great Harvest Franchise 
• Revamped Great Harvest’s franchise site, transforming an outdated tab into a fully responsive marketing page with Next.js, TypeScript, and HubSpot form integration, enhancing site functionality and supporting franchise growth.
• Attracted 17 qualified franchise prospects across the United States within 30 days of launch, supporting Great Harvest’s expansion into new markets through a high-converting digital presence.

Nemonx 
• Refactored Nemonx’s resume builder using React.js, Nest.js, and Prisma by adding new UI elements, updating backend endpoints for dynamic data handling, and resolving a critical bug that was preventing resume generation. 
• Shipped 5 new resume templates that doubled design variety and significantly enhanced the student user experience.

ManMarketing / MyJulia
•  Improved MyJulia’s website performance by 15% through image compression and code refinement, enhancing load times and user experience, and tested performance with Lighthouse under contract with ManMarketing.

Advanced Building Services
• Constructed a tailored user interface for Advanced Building Services’ landing page, improving user engagement and attracting 300+ unique visitors in the first month, with positive feedback on usability and functionality.
positions.insights: React.js, Content Management Systems (CMS) and +4 skills

•Organized and verified insurance for approximately 400 patient’s accounts at a time by using RescueNet's tools
